pillars.name: ERP & Enterprise Business Operations
pillars.description: Open-source ERP backends, agent-native bookkeeping engines, workflow bridges, invoicing compliance, and business MCP servers.

pillars.name: Documentation, Knowledge & Content Ingestion
pillars.description: Document parsers (PDF/DOCX/OCR), web crawlers for LLMs, collaborative wikis with native MCP, and codebase documentation agents.

pillars.name: AI Agent Frameworks, Orchestration & Memory
pillars.description: TypeScript-native agent frameworks, reactive frontend copilot SDKs, cyclic state graphs, memory operating systems, and sandboxes.

items.name: Open Mercato
items.tagline: AI-engineering modular foundation for CRM, ERP, and commerce in TypeScript & PostgreSQL.
items.summary: Built on TypeScript, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, Open Mercato provides ~80% of enterprise foundation out-of-the-box: multi-tenancy, RBAC, audit trails, and modular business domains designed specifically for AI coding agents to extend.
items.architecturalFit: Perfect match for e's stack (TypeScript, PostgreSQL, multi-tenancy). e can adopt its modular schema conventions for quotation-to-invoice workflows, contact management, and role-based data isolation.

items.name: Accounted (by ERP Mafia)
items.tagline: Agent-native open-source ERP and double-entry bookkeeping engine with 150+ MCP tools.
items.summary: Built from scratch to be operated by AI agents rather than human data-entry clerks. Implements strict GAAP/IFRS double-entry accounting rules, immutable vouchers, bank reconciliation (PSD2), VAT, and Peppol e-invoicing.
items.architecturalFit: Directly empowers e's invoice-audit and demo-expenses modules. Instead of custom balance logic, e agents can call Accounted's 150+ vetted accounting tools with human-in-the-loop sign-off.

items.name: ERPNext MCP Server & Frappe
items.tagline: TypeScript Model Context Protocol server connecting AI assistants to ERPNext & Frappe.
items.summary: Connects AI models to ERPNext via official APIs. Exposes ERPNext documents via custom URIs (erpnext://{doctype}/{name}), fetches schemas, runs financial reports, and executes whitelisted server methods.
items.architecturalFit: Enables e to act as an autonomous Copilot on top of customer ERPNext instances for live stock lookup, PO creation, and balance inquiries.

items.name: Odoo MCP Server
items.tagline: Connects AI models to Odoo ERP via XML-RPC and native JSON-RPC modules.
items.summary: Allows LLMs to query business data, search/create/update records, run server-side aggregations, and trigger actions like invoice posting or sales order confirmation via natural language.
items.architecturalFit: Allows e to integrate with existing SME and enterprise clients who run Odoo on-premise or cloud, bridging e's document intelligence directly into Odoo accounting.

items.name: Activepieces Platform MCP
items.tagline: Open-source Zapier alternative with a Universal MCP Gateway providing 760+ prebuilt business tools.
items.summary: Activepieces has first-class native MCP server support. Pointing any MCP client to Activepieces instantly exposes tools for 760+ applications including Slack, QuickBooks, Salesforce, Google Drive, Hubspot, and Shopify.
items.architecturalFit: Eliminates writing 50+ one-off business integrations for e. With a single Activepieces MCP connection, e agents gain certified tools across enterprise SaaS.

items.name: n8n Workflow Automation & MCP
items.tagline: Fair-code workflow automation platform with dual MCP builder and MCP client capabilities.
items.summary: n8n provides visual workflow orchestration with specialized MCP packages (spences10/mcp-n8n-builder, coleam00/n8n-nodes-mcp). Allows LLMs to programmatically create and run complex multi-step automations.
items.architecturalFit: e's orchestrator can offload complex scheduled jobs, multi-step webhooks, and retry logic to n8n while maintaining chat-based oversight.

items.name: Stripe Agent Toolkit & Remote MCP
items.tagline: Official Stripe agent toolkit and remote MCP server for payments, subscriptions, and billing.
items.summary: Stripe's official AI repository offers hosted and local MCP servers (mcp.stripe.com) that empower agents to inspect customers, issue invoices, configure payment links, and verify subscription status securely.
items.architecturalFit: Directly satisfies e's requirement for invoice billing, credit notes, payment collection, and customer balance resolution with OAuth-grade security.

items.name: Documenso TypeScript MCP
items.tagline: Open-source DocuSign alternative with native MCP server inside its TypeScript SDK.
items.summary: Documenso provides digital document signing, audit trails, and legal templates. Its official TypeScript SDK (@documenso/sdk-typescript) doubles as an installable MCP server via npx.
items.architecturalFit: Enables e's Document Intelligence agents to dispatch quotations and POs for electronic signature, listen for completion webhooks, and archive signed PDFs into company records.

items.name: Cal.com MCP Server
items.tagline: Official Model Context Protocol server for enterprise scheduling and booking management.
items.summary: Enables LLMs to view availability, schedule bookings, reschedule meetings, and handle attendees automatically with timezone-aware conflict resolution.
items.architecturalFit: Integrates directly with e's existing /calendar route, allowing agents to schedule customer consultations, procurement vendor calls, and internal reviews.

items.name: Plane MCP Server
items.tagline: Open-source Jira/Linear alternative with official Model Context Protocol server.
items.summary: Exposes project workspaces, cycles, modules, issue tracking, and custom work items directly to AI agents as structured tools.
items.architecturalFit: Enables e's durable job orchestrator to mirror background tasks and specialist assignments into visible team Kanban boards and sprint trackers.

items.name: InvoiceXML MCP Server
items.tagline: Global e-invoicing standards (Factur-X, ZUGFeRD, XRechnung, Peppol BIS 3.0) for AI agents.
items.summary: Translates conversational billing prompts and JSON objects into mathematically validated, legally compliant XML e-invoices conforming to Peppol BIS 3.0, UBL/CII, and ZUGFeRD.
items.architecturalFit: Mandatory for enterprise and government e-invoicing compliance (e.g. LHDN MyInvois in Malaysia, EU mandates), preventing invalid schema rejections.

items.name: ERPClaw
items.tagline: AI-native ERP operated via conversational plain language instead of manual form entry.
items.summary: Re-architects standard ERP modules (accounting, inventory, sales, purchasing) from the ground up around natural language queries and automated agent action dispatchers.
items.architecturalFit: Serves as an architectural reference for conversational inventory checks, supplier re-orders, and automated purchase approval workflows in e.
items.quickConfig:
# Clone and inspect core conversational dispatcher
git clone https://github.com/avansaber/erpclaw.git

items.name: Docling & Docling MCP (IBM)
items.tagline: IBM's premier document parser converting complex PDFs, DOCX, scans, and tables into structured Markdown.
items.summary: Docling parses PDFs, scanned documents, DOCX, PPTX, and HTML into high-fidelity markdown and JSON. It excels at preserving nested tables, multi-column reading order, formulas, and visual document layouts.
items.architecturalFit: Massive upgrade for e's Document Intelligence and invoice auditing. Replaces brittle regexes with layout-aware document understanding for receipts, POs, and utility bills.

items.name: MarkItDown & MCP (Microsoft)
items.tagline: Microsoft's official file-to-markdown converter for Office docs, Excel spreadsheets, and PDFs.
items.summary: Lightweight, robust Python utility that converts Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint decks, PDFs, images, and audio metadata into clean Markdown optimized for LLM token budgets.
items.architecturalFit: e regularly processes package-sheet CLI files and Excel price lists. MarkItDown converts Excel rows into formatted Markdown tables instantly for context packs.

items.name: Crawl4AI & MCP
items.tagline: Open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper with stealth mode and markdown distillation.
items.summary: High-performance web crawler designed explicitly for AI agents. Features anti-detection stealth browsing, structured JSON extraction, heuristic markdown distillation, and multi-URL concurrency.
items.architecturalFit: Complements e's existing Scrapling engine for company deep research, competitor price tracking, and merchant website audit jobs.

items.name: Firecrawl & Firecrawl MCP
items.tagline: Turn entire websites into LLM-ready markdown with site mapping, deep crawl, and structured extraction.
items.summary: Recursively crawls web domains, bypassing JS rendering roadblocks, stripping ads and navbars, and returning clean hierarchical markdown documents for RAG indexing.
items.architecturalFit: Enables e to ingest complete vendor documentation websites, product catalogs, and partner knowledge bases in a single asynchronous job.

items.name: Outline Team Wiki & Native MCP
items.tagline: Modern collaborative knowledge base with native built-in Model Context Protocol server.
items.summary: Outline has official, built-in MCP server capabilities (/mcp) supporting OAuth and API keys. AI assistants can read, search, create, update, and manage company documentation directly.
items.architecturalFit: Provides e with an enterprise-grade living knowledge base for storing SOPs, company dossiers, product specifications, and agent-generated reports.

items.name: Context7 Documentation MCP (Upstash)
items.tagline: Feeds live, version-specific library documentation & code examples directly into AI assistants.
items.summary: Stops hallucinated API calls by pulling real, version-accurate documentation for npm, PyPI, and cloud libraries straight into the AI agent's prompt during tool invocation.
items.architecturalFit: Ensures e's coding agents and script runners (e.g. website studio, browser automation) use exact, current API signatures rather than out-of-date training memories.

items.name: OpenAPI / Swagger to MCP Bridge
items.tagline: Turn any OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger REST API into an MCP server automatically.
items.summary: Reads openapi.json or swagger.yaml specs, generates typed MCP tool definitions for every endpoint with parameter validation, and executes authorized HTTP calls dynamically.
items.architecturalFit: e has internal endpoints (manage-api, demo-api). This bridge lets e auto-expose its own backend routes and 3rd-party merchant APIs to agents with zero boilerplate.

items.name: RepoAgent (OpenBMB)
items.tagline: LLM-powered repository documentation agent with AST-based diff tracking and call mapping.
items.summary: Monitors Git commits, parses code syntax trees (AST) to recognize modified functions/classes, traces callers, and surgically rewrites markdown docs to prevent doc rot.
items.architecturalFit: Complements e's Graft context system by maintaining synchronized markdown documentation and architecture overviews across iterations.
items.quickConfig:
# Run RepoAgent against local workspace
repoagent run --model gpt-4o --target-repo .

items.name: AI Doc Gen
items.tagline: Multi-agent codebase documentation generator generating AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and architecture maps.
items.summary: Specialized multi-agent system where independent agents map dependencies, request pipelines, and database models to generate comprehensive AI assistant instruction manuals and READMEs.
items.architecturalFit: Automates creating and maintaining e's context packs (agent/context/<slug>/) and AGENTS.md rule guides as the platform evolves.
items.quickConfig:
# Generate agent context and architecture documentation
npx ai-doc-gen --target . --output agent-docs

items.name: OpenWiki CLI
items.tagline: Turns codebases into hyperlinked Markdown wikis with exact line-level evidence tracking.
items.summary: Generates a fully indexed, cross-referenced Markdown wiki from source code. Tracks each claim back to source files and exposes a native MCP server for agents to navigate repository knowledge.
items.architecturalFit: Bridges developer comprehension and agent reasoning, offering an instant knowledge base of e's codebase for Pi runtime processes.

items.name: Fumadocs
items.tagline: Modern, fast documentation framework for Next.js & React with full-text search and OpenAPI rendering.
items.summary: High-performance React documentation framework featuring built-in search (Orama/FlexSearch), automated OpenAPI playground generation, dynamic MDX widgets, and responsive UI.
items.architecturalFit: Ideal for powering e's internal documentation portal, developer manual, and interactive API reference in React.

items.name: Scalar API Documentation
items.tagline: Modern, interactive API reference and Swagger/OpenAPI client with offline themeable UI.
items.summary: Stunning open-source alternative to Swagger UI and Postman. Embeds directly into Node.js / Express / Fastify / React apps, generating interactive API playgrounds with code generation in 15+ languages.
items.architecturalFit: e can embed Scalar at /api/docs to provide an interactive, tested API explorer for all backend endpoints and native MCP tools.
items.quickConfig:
import { apiReference } from '@scalar/express-api-reference';
app.use('/api/docs', apiReference({ spec: { content: openApiSchema } }));

items.name: Mastra AI
items.tagline: The premier TypeScript-native AI agent framework for Node.js: typed workflows, Zod tools, evals & MCP.
items.summary: Mastra is designed from the ground up for TypeScript/Node.js. It features autonomous agents with dynamic tool execution, deterministic multi-step workflows, long-term memory, built-in eval scoring, and native MCP support.
items.architecturalFit: Exact 1:1 stack match with e's Node.js backend. Mastra can power e's next-generation execution runner (server/execution/), replacing bespoke Pi process management with standardized durable workflows.

items.name: CopilotKit & CoAgents
items.tagline: Open-source React framework for in-app AI copilots, generative UI, and CoAgents shared state.
items.summary: Bridges complex backend agents (LangGraph, Mastra, custom runners) directly into React frontends. Features bidirectional shared state, streaming intermediate steps, generative UI widgets, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
items.architecturalFit: Direct drop-in for e's React 19 frontend. Replaces custom streaming chat hooks with battle-tested generative UI components that render live interactive cards for invoices, tables, and charts.

items.name: LangGraph.js
items.tagline: Cyclic graph multi-agent orchestrator with state persistence, time-travel debugging, and human approvals.
items.summary: Graph-based framework for stateful, multi-actor LLM applications. Provides durable checkpoints (PostgreSQL adapter), branch execution, time-travel state rollback, and explicit interrupt-for-approval flows.
items.architecturalFit: Perfect for e's multi-step jobs (e.g. procurement approval, monthly expense audit) where an agent must pause, wait for manager sign-off, and resume without losing state.

items.name: Letta (formerly MemGPT)
items.tagline: Stateful agent operating system with hierarchical memory (working, core, archival) and self-evolution.
items.summary: Treats LLM context windows like RAM in an operating system. Agents manage their own memory: saving important user preferences to core memory, searching archival vector memory, and preserving state across months of conversation.
items.architecturalFit: Solves e's multi-session memory. An e agent will remember vendor negotiation history, client preferences, and past accounting quirks across separate chat sessions.

items.name: Browser Use & Browser-Use Pi
items.tagline: Autonomous browser automation agent using vision and Chrome DevTools Protocol to execute web tasks.
items.summary: With 118k+ stars, Browser Use is the most popular agentic web automation framework. It allows LLMs to see web pages (DOM + screenshots), click buttons, fill multi-page forms, solve captchas, and scrape protected web portals.
items.architecturalFit: Supercharges e's browser.mjs and newpages.mjs for automated merchant portal logins, supplier invoice downloads, and government portal filings.

items.name: ElizaOS
items.tagline: Modular autonomous multi-agent runtime written in TypeScript with 50+ multi-channel plugins.
items.summary: Popular TypeScript agent runtime featuring modular plugins for Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Twitter/X, and SQL databases. Provides extensible memory stores and personality profiles.
items.architecturalFit: Directly enhances e's WhatsApp worker (whatsapp-worker.mjs) and multi-channel notification dispatchers with conversational continuity and media handling.

items.name: Dify Orchestrator
items.tagline: Leading open-source LLM app development and visual multi-agent orchestration platform.
items.summary: Full-featured platform combining visual workflow building, hybrid RAG retrieval, agent prompt management, tool integrations, and detailed execution observability.
items.architecturalFit: Enterprise reference architecture for e. e can borrow Dify's visual workflow paradigms, prompt versioning schemas, and multi-tenant telemetry dashboards.
items.quickConfig:
# Spin up Dify self-hosted container cluster
cd dify/docker && docker compose up -d

items.name: Pydantic AI
items.tagline: Production-grade, type-safe Python agent framework with strict validation and Logfire observability.
items.summary: Built by the Pydantic team, bringing FastAPI-like ergonomics and compile-time type validation to AI agents. Offers native Model Context Protocol support, model agility, and Pydantic Graph control flow.
items.architecturalFit: The premier choice for e's Python-based worker microservices (e.g. Scrapling, PDF layout analysis, financial reconciliation math).
items.quickConfig:
from pydantic_ai import Agent
from pydantic_ai.mcp import McpServer
agent = Agent('google-gla:gemini-2.0-flash', deps_type=DatabasePool)

items.name: OpenHands (All-Hands AI)
items.tagline: Autonomous software development agent platform with sandboxed Docker execution and web canvas.
items.summary: Complete platform for autonomous coding agents: edits files, executes terminal commands inside Docker containers, tests code, browses the web, and integrates with GitHub pull requests.
items.architecturalFit: Direct reference architecture for e's Website Studio and code-editing workspaces (sites-cli.mjs, visual-pass.mjs).
items.quickConfig:
# Run OpenHands sandboxed agent in Docker
docker run -it --rm -p 3000:3000 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock ghcr.io/all-hands-ai/openhands:latest

items.name: FastMCP for TypeScript
items.tagline: High-performance TypeScript framework for building production MCP servers with Zod schemas & SSE.
items.summary: Eliminates boilerplate when building MCP servers in TypeScript. Automatically infers tool schemas from Zod, supports authentication, typed progress events, and stdio/SSE/HTTP transports seamlessly.
items.architecturalFit: The recommended standard for refactoring e's existing MCP servers (sales-mcp-server, google-ads-mcp-server, ee-mail-mcp-server) into clean, maintainable, typed microservices.

items.name: E2B Cloud & Local Sandboxes
items.tagline: Secure sandboxed execution environment for AI agents to run code safely in sub-second startup.
items.summary: Provides isolated micro-VM sandboxes where AI agents can execute untrusted code (Python, JS, Bash, charts, calculations) safely without endangering the host server or database.
items.architecturalFit: Critical security shield for e. When agents generate data analysis charts or run Python mathematical calculations during invoice audits, E2B guarantees full container isolation.

items.name: Smolagents (Hugging Face)
items.tagline: Lightweight code-first agent framework where agents write expressive Python actions instead of JSON.
items.summary: Instead of verbose multi-step JSON tool calls, smolagents has LLMs write short Python scripts to chain tools, execute loops, and manipulate data structures with ~1,000 lines of core framework code.
items.architecturalFit: Inspires code-as-action workflows for e's complex data auditing, allowing agents to execute complex mathematical transforms on large financial CSVs in a single step.
items.quickConfig:
from smolagents import CodeAgent, HfApiModel
agent = CodeAgent(tools=[invoice_tool, stock_tool], model=HfApiModel())
agent.run('Find all invoices exceeding PO budget by 10%')
